name: Batman: Arkham Origins Vita
author: KiddRwxSsj
description: Batman: Arkham Origins is a mobile fighting game developed by NetherRealm Studios and published by WB Games. The player controls Batman in one-on-one combat against enemies across Gotham City, using strikes, counters and swipe-based combos, unlocking abilities and batsuits as progression advances. This is a port of the Android version (1.3.0) to PS Vita, running the game's original code natively through a so-loader, with physical button mapping, a native movie player and offline-only play.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
